en: Restores a large amount of HP and PWR.
Deal (PWR) damage to the frontmost enemy.
When attacking, if target has more HP than holder then perform an extra attack.
Add (HP) HP and (PWR) PWR to the unit.
A simple but reliable enchanted charm.
At the start of the turn, Heals the frontmost ally unit by 2 HP.
When hurt, Heal this unit by 1 HP.
When hurt, Heal this unit by 1 HP.
When hurt, Counter-attack the attacker for damage equal to this unit's current PWR. Triggers on final time when the damage to this unit is lethal.
At the start of the turn, Heal the holder for 2 HP.
When an ally is defeated, gain +1 HP and +1 PWR.
Excess damage from lethal attacks is dealt to the adjacent unit behind the target.
When hurt, grants +1 HP and +1 PWR to adjacent allies.
Summons a random Tier 1 unit upon death.
